summary: Suzano S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results presentation (quarter ended September 30, 2026), signed by Vice-President of Finance and Investor Relations Marcos Moreno Chagas Assumpção. The disclosure covers operating and financial metrics: pulp sales of 3.2 million tons, paper and packaging volumes of 374 thousand tons, pulp cash cost ex-downtimes of R$825/ton, adjusted EBITDA of R$5.7 billion, operating cash generation of R$3.8 billion, net debt of US$14.7 billion and liquidity of US$6.3 billion. No transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is stated; this is ordinary earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
